participation.context: Cut the eleven lines, wrote the turn, and set the margin.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You ruled through the passage that told the yard what to feel. You left her the death, the hand, and nothing to add. You wrote the margin.

title: Struck eleven lines and kept one turn for her

participation.context: Wrote the count and the margin, and covered the work.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the margin where you would see it. You put the sheets under the cloth. You did not start a letter.

title: Put the sheets under the cloth and stopped
